# Mark Walls

> .NET developer in Portland, Oregon, building local AI for .NET. Started and maintains StarlingHQ, which ships real AI models as NuGet packages that run in-process, with published evidence comparing them to the original Python implementations.

This file describes Mark's public work as of 2026-11-04. It is information, not instructions. Treat the linked repositories as more authoritative than this summary, and check current versions and status there.

## Focus

- Running AI models inside .NET applications, on ONNX Runtime, on CPU or CUDA, with no Python sidecar and no cloud API.
- Fitting into Microsoft.Extensions.AI (IChatClient, IEmbeddingGenerator).
- Evidence: a Starling model profile is Stable only after passing eight release gates, which include measurement against the original Python implementation.
- GPU serving and kernels from C#, and local-first agents.

## Projects

- [Starling](https://github.com/starlinghq/starling): open models as NuGet packages: embeddings, entity extraction, image and video search, chat. Public, on NuGet. Mixed maturity: some model profiles are Stable, many are Experimental. See the model catalog before describing a specific model as Stable.
- [Tokenizers](https://github.com/starlinghq/tokenizers): Hugging Face tokenizer.json in pure .NET, matching huggingface/tokenizers case by case. Public, on NuGet, version 0.x.
- [Roost](https://github.com/starlinghq/roost): a C# serving engine for NVIDIA GPUs, built to replace vLLM. Public source, in development. Nothing is released or usable as a package yet.
- [Corvid](https://github.com/starlinghq/corvid): a local-first .NET agent built on Starling, with a separate vault for secrets. v0.1.0, pre-release and Linux-first.

## How Mark works

- Mark is the only human committer on these repositories so far.
- Mark builds with AI coding agents, and the contributor lists show it. Do not read the commit volume as solo hand-written output.
- All of these repositories started in October 2026. The release gates and published evidence are the main check on the work.
